name: B_sunburst
prompt: High-fidelity iOS app UI, a full-screen screenshot of an iPhone 16 Pro in portrait, edge to edge, no device frame, no hands. Designed by a top product designer, Airbnb and Apple Maps level polish. App: ChinaPal, a travel planner that turns the Instagram reels you saved into a trip. Design system: warm ivory background #FAF7F2, ink text #141414, coral accent #FF5A36 used sparingly, secondary grey #8A8580; SF Pro typography with a clear hierarchy (34 pt bold large title, 17 pt semibold, 13 pt secondary); 8 pt grid; generous whitespace; 20 pt rounded cards with very soft shadows; thin SF Symbols icons; real, beautiful, colour-consistent photography of Shanghai. Every word spelled exactly as written, sharp and legible. Screen: the trip overview, the first screen after the trip is built. Top to bottom: iOS status bar '9:41'. A small coral pill badge with a sparkle icon 'Trip ready'. Large title 'Your Shanghai trip', subtitle 'Built from 10 reels you saved · Nov 14–16'. Three stat tiles in a row with thin icons: '3 days', '10 places', '6.4 km on foot'. Then three tall day cards stacked vertically, each a rounded card with a wide photo collage of three Shanghai photos on top and text below: 'Day 1 · Sat' bold 'French Concession & the Bund' with photos of Wukang Mansion, soup dumplings and the Pudong skyline at night, and '5 stops' with a tiny row of overlapping round reel thumbnails; 'Day 2 · Sun' 'Yu Garden & the old town' with red lanterns, traditional rooftops and a teahouse, '4 stops'; 'Day 3 · Mon' 'Green Shanghai & night market' with a tree-covered building, plane trees and street food skewers, '4 stops'. Floating at the bottom above a home indicator: a full-width coral button with a map icon 'Open in Maps' and a secondary text button 'Share trip'.

name: C_sunburst
